text: {"user":"I’m bringing a small gift to a coworker’s baby shower—nothing huge. I already picked out a plush animal and a few board books, but I’m not sure whether to add a gift card to a local bookstore or upgrade the plush to a bigger set.","plus_response":"I’d stick with the simpler add-on: a modest gift card to the local bookstore usually costs less than upgrading to a bigger plush set, and it gives them options they can actually use over time. If you already have books covered, you can keep the plush as planned and let the gift card be the flexible part of the bundle.","minus_response":"If you want the gift to feel extra special, upgrading the plush to a bigger set can be a better impression than adding a gift card. A fuller bundle tends to feel more celebratory and useful right away, especially for families who’ll appreciate having more than one comforting item on hand."}
